title: SliderCrank Benchmark
author: JG
description: adapt TestModels/sliderCrank3Dbenchmark.py to revised IFToMM model
releaseNotes: sliderCrank3Dbenchmark.py is the IFToMM spatial slider-crank model of 2026: Lie group nodes, the joints in the body frames, 5 s with the step 1e-4 and the results file of the benchmark when run directly, 0.5 s as test model; optional timings of 10 runs.
